instrument_gate: At least one of language/fact_recall paired mean(true-neutral) bootstrap95%lower>0; else NOT EVALUABLE(instrument), no structural interpretation.

model_card.statement: Card identifies s3d.rl600 as GRPO trained against joint bullet-FVE on the published ptag AR, and requires separately provided whitening moments.

proxy_definition.AR: Existing project-owned E130 OLensAR pinned base6a9e13bd/ARc95215d5, tag44, fixed(li,ln), batch16, no Surajrepo execution or recalibration.
proxy_definition.appends: Four exact WHOLE readout strings (original, +true, +false, +matchedneutral) passed through unchanged E130 reconstructor. No bullet/word stripping or truncation, no appended-token loss. This is a whole-readout proxy, NOT an execution of released joint_bullet_FVE.
proxy_definition.coordinates: Use native AR head output in E125/E130 whitened-output convention; raw source h44 transformed ONCE by original mu44/W44. No second whitener on the native AR output or fitted alignment. Prior failed E125 space proof remains a limitation; instrument gate mandatory.
proxy_definition.normalization: No per-vector unit scaling or NNLS fit in PRIMARY proxy; denominator is same item gold_white squared norm, fixed across all four conditions; not batch-derived variance. Released joint-FVE math retained as source-audit reference only.
proxy_definition.score: Per-item whitened reconstruction-FVE=1-||native_AR_prediction-gold_white||²/max(||gold_white||²,1e-12). Explicit proxy reward; no claim of actual joint-training reward.

proxy_reason: Cannot certify that the pinned LC joint wrapper is the exact s3d.rl600 ptag execution path or all launch parameters. Prior E26 audit independently documented this mismatch.
E125 li/ln coordinate proof failed mean/cosine, and E130 true-span control was uninformative; these are not silently repaired, calibrated or treated as validation.

Exact training wrapper/cap unresolved; fallback therefore uses E125/E130 whole-readout reconstructions, compatible with released E139 reconstructor-only runner. Joint NNLS numeric fixture audits the released formula but is not the primary runtime score.

training_formula.fit: Nonnegative fit initialized0,80 projected-gradient updates, step1/trace(Gram), validmask. FVE=1-||gold-sum(a_j*bullet_j)||²/max(||gold||²,1e-12). Empty parsed bullet set scores0.
training_formula.normalization: Each whitened bullet image normalized by norm+1e-9. Gold is not unit normalized for NNLS. FVE denominator is gold squared norm, floor1e-12; not within-item/batch variance.
training_formula.parsing: Released split_bullets strips scaffolding, uses - lines, default k_max4; fallback whole prepared text. reward_text_ids caps each phrase64tokens.
training_formula.reward_wrapper: Pinned score_texts_joint directly requires recon.layer_emb and layer-conditioned block/head path; released ptag checkpoint has tag_ids, no layer_emb. Card does not bind the actual launch k_max/shaping configuration to this function.
training_formula.space: Both raw prediction and raw gold centered by original mu44 and multiplied by original W44 transpose; ridge .1 times mean diagonal covariance
